title: Keynote: Flutter (Dart Developer Summit 2016)
summary: Keynote from the 2016 Dart Developer Summit introducing Flutter, Google's toolkit for building mobile apps from one codebase. It shows early demos aimed at native look and feel.
why: Recommended as the early introduction to Flutter's single-codebase iOS and Android approach.

quote.text: I'm looking into Flutter/Dart from Google for building iOS/Android apps from the same codebase.
